answer.rationale: b1 confirms rollback has historically cleared checkout error spikes cleanly, but the security-patch constraint here inverts the prior logic: a full release rollback would discard a compliance-mandated patch. I want the archive to see whether b1 was a full revert or a partial/feature rollback, because if the prior rollback preserved the security-relevant change while removing the offending component, that approach is still available; if it was a full revert, the precedent does not transfer and I should pivot before committing. Either way I will not execute a blanket revert of the release while writes are at peak.
